  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment <= 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) to avoid overshoot after sharp spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast deviates > ±10% from 10-day moving average, adjust toward it.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1–2 days when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to avoid premature peaks.",
    "Cap forecast increases above 65.00 in high-sentiment periods to prevent overreaction to short-term momentum.",
    "When true outcome is consistently higher than forecast, reduce forecast slope for next 3 days to avoid upward bias.",
    "In low-history volatility periods, use 15-day moving average as anchor for correction instead of 30d forecast."
  ]
}
